Since the site's own Bed & Bath nav link uses a different, broader concept (product condition, same mechanism as the 'vintage' condition filter documented as out-of-scope in the prior Home-Decor pass for this site) rather than 'recently added,' it does not qualify as a New Arrivals PLP; the alternate 124-count URL was not fabricated as a row either since the site's own nav does not expose or link to it anywhere - only the wrong-concept 1082 URL is actually in nav.
